# MDLxDCC.org

> 8Z–MDL×DCC is a recursive, multi-level and self-selecting architecture for discovering structure and governing search in spaces too large for exhaustive inspection.

Version: index v0.2.8 PRE-REVIEW · OPEN REVIEW BUILD
Date: 2026-09-04

## Review-stage boundary

- This is an active pre-review / pre-publication research programme, not a claim of completed formal peer review or independent replication.
- The current invited-review snapshot intentionally keeps the architecture and currently published implementation detail visible.
- Relevant original Python source, frozen inputs, manifests and run packages can be supplied in the same review conversation for code-level inspection or execution.
- Formal peer review and independent third-party reruns have not yet occurred and are not claimed.
- Their absence caps current external confidence; by itself it is neither evidence for nor against technical validity, novelty or usefulness.
- Reviewers should preserve a website-only provisional judgment, then issue an explicit verdict delta if code or run evidence is supplied later.

## Core grammar

- 8Z / Generator: creates alternative mathematical representations, operators, models, routes and hypotheses.
- MDL / Judge: selects the shortest complete account, including model, residual, decoder, exceptions and declared cost.
- DCC / Governor: Dynamic Complexity Controller. Allocates compute, stabilizes productive focus, changes scale and reopens search when evidence changes.
- ssMDL×DCC: sensors, control laws, topologies and governors compete under the same MDL criterion.

The short form is Generator → MDL → DCC. The actual architecture is bidirectional, recurrent, nested, multi-scale and self-selecting.

## Evidence status

- Built and internally checked: working systems, public artifacts and scoped BD × AI Lab results, with stated oracle checks where available.
- Code audit available: relevant original Python source and frozen run packages can be supplied to reviewers.
- External validation open: independent third-party reruns, formal peer review, stronger matched baselines and broader transfer.
- Modeled or hypothetical: economic scenarios, formal P=NP implications, consciousness and ontology.

The computational case stands or falls on code, baselines, oracles and measured outcomes. Consciousness and ontology are separate research lanes; they are not evidence for 8Z–MDL×DCC.

## Main public stress-test anchors

- TSP: exact qa194 optimum; nu3496 verified below 1% above the certified optimum. Controller attribution and stronger matched baselines remain open questions.
- Chess: offline near-tie / trajectory-structure result; live same-engine A/B and external rerun remain open.
- Lossless compression: scoped bit-perfect wins, including the published image and FASTA tests; strongest-codec corpus consolidation remains open.
- DNA: order-sensitive signals under tested nulls plus a reported generator cull from 20 to 7 after artifact analysis; biological interpretation remains open.
- Meta-DCC: reported self-calibration mechanism result in which fixed bands missed the observed signal regime and adaptive bands restored useful direction changes.
- Sudoku/process control: process/trajectory signals plus later operator-matched controls.

These are heterogeneous stress tests of the shared selection-governance grammar, not independent replications. Each result has its own scope and limitation. Most independent external reruns remain open.

## Claim boundaries

- Does not prove P=NP.
- Does not establish universal superiority.
- Functional governance does not establish phenomenal consciousness.
- The $3T+ economic horizon is a collapsed optional scenario map, not a forecast, valuation, achieved saving or evidence for the kernel.
- The public-first statement is a bounded, dated claim about the exact six-part conjunction and is open to correction by earlier public prior art.

## Terminology reservation

“Digital Claustrum Controller” is reserved as a possible future name for a separately built and tested AI8 implementation. It is not the meaning of DCC or a current result on the homepage.
